basic_details.job_title: CGSSB Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 1703 Assistant, Registration Clerk and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Chhattisgarh Staff Selection Board, Raipur (CGSSB) has invited applications for 1703 posts in 10 roles under Advt No. एस.एस.बी./परीक्षा एफ-20/2026/4422. The posts include Stenographer (Hindi), Stenographer (English), Stenographer (Bilingual), Sub Inspector - A (Stenographer) (General Branch) (Hindi) and 6 more. The online application is open from 5 November 2026 to 27 November 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Post-wise qualification not printed in this notice; the exam is for Group-2, Class III (Post Graduate and Graduate level) Sub Group-02 posts. Details on https://cgssb.cgstate.gov.in

how_to_apply: Apply online on the Board's portal https://cgssb.cgstate.gov.in between 05-11-2026 and 27-11-2026 (till 5:00 PM).
Pay the exam fee online while filling the online application.
Correct errors in the online application from 28-11-2026 to 30-11-2026 (till 5:00 PM).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CGSSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 27 November 2026. Applications opened on 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CGSSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 1703 vacancies: 30 Stenographer (Hindi), 3 Stenographer (English), 13 Stenographer (Bilingual), 34 Sub Inspector - A (Stenographer) (General Branch) (Hindi), 25 Data Entry Operator, 23 Steno Typist and 4 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CGSSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Local residents of Chhattisgarh who appear in the exam: Exam fee refunded to the same bank account from which it was paid.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post-wise qualification not printed in this notice; the exam is for Group-2, Class III (Post Graduate and Graduate level) Sub Group-02 posts. Details on https://cgssb.cgstate.gov.in. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Local residents of Chhattisgarh state are eligible for fee refund upon appearing in the exam.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written recruitment examination (G20227). Written recruitment exam G20227 on 10-01-2027 from 10:00 to 12:15. Exam centres at 05 divisional headquarters. Admit card to be issued on the website, probable date 04-01-2027.
